headline: Lotte Rental Shares Hit Fifty-Two-Week High on TPG Tender Offer
summary: Lotte Rental shares touched a 52-week high after private equity firm TPG launched a $613 million tender offer for the company.
why: Large private equity tender offers typically trigger sharp revaluations in target company equities, bringing premiums to pre-announcement trading levels.

impacts.name: Lotte Rental Co
impacts.why: TPG launched a $613 million tender offer, driving Lotte Rental shares to a 52-week high.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The announcement of a multi-million-dollar cash tender offer by private equity firm TPG prompted immediate buying pressure and drove shares to a 52-week high.
